title: hookForm: the refusals and texts rows declare no visibleWhen, so the designer offers them on an expression-body hook the schema refuses them on
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As8yeqbR9TKANdPKRxt

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named site, reported by o7-studio's dev and measured by o7-spec at seat repo:objectstack#7's order. Source: fleet.

## Measured (spec form definition, origin/main bbc7e037f3)
`packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts`: the `refusals` row (line 58) and the `texts` row (line 82) carry no `visibleWhen` — `git show origin/main:packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts | grep -n visibleWhen` returns 0 hits. Their own help text says "For a JavaScript (L2) body or a handler; refused on an expression body", and the schema refuses both there: `packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts` (refusals ~l.307–311, texts ~l.352–356) issue at `path: ['refusals']` / `['texts']` unless `body.language === 'js'`, or there is no body and a handler is set.
reach: named real producer — the served `hookForm` (metadata form registry) the Studio hook editor draws; on a hook whose `body.language` is `expression` both rows are offered, and filling either makes the save refuse. Read from the definition, not run in a browser.

## Ask
Give both rows a `visibleWhen` matching the schema's own test (shown for a `js` body, or for no body with a handler), in the expression dialect the other `*.form.ts` rows use (`field.form.ts` `minLength` is the pattern). A pin in `packages/spec` that walks `hookForm` and reads the two predicates, plus a check that they agree with the refinement on the three cases (expression body, js body, handler only).

## Business reason
An author writing an expression hook is offered two sections that can only make their save fail; hiding them is what the schema already says.

Hands-on reader: o7-spec (seat repo:objectstack#7).
Dedupe: open+closed issues for `hookForm refusals visibleWhen` (3: #36725 open — a different mechanism, the two Studio hosts not passing the served form rows; #35650 closed; #19403 closed), `hook.form refusals texts expression body` (0).

Suggested-grade: p3 · authoring-surface offers refused keys, save refuses with a clear issue · suggested domain `domain:spec` · area:build · for triage first touch.
